comment: The blood-pressure example uses SNOMED CT concept 271649006 for systolic blood pressure and LOINC 8480-6 as an “equivalent.” These codes may represent related observations in different terminology models rather than simple exact equivalence.

public.text: The blood-pressure example uses SNOMED CT concept 271649006 for systolic blood pressure and LOINC 8480-6 as an “equivalent.” These codes may represent related observations in different terminology models rather than simple exact equivalence.
public.suggestedRevision: Avoid presenting the relationship as unqualified equivalence. State that mappings have context, purpose, and equivalence properties and must be governed and validated for the intended use.
